title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence across analytic number theory, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.2.0 adds six new kernel-verified modules (32,872 new lines): (1) unconditional differential transcendence over C(t) of the Flajolet–Richmond generalized digital tree EGF f_b(t) and Poisson transform e^{-t}f_b(t) for every b >= 2 (closing the open f half of Bostan–Di Vizio–Raschel, AJM 2024, §2.2.6 Example #3) plus the exact b = 1 collapse f_1(t) = t e^t; (2) Sibuya's Sub-Gevrey Convergence Theorem and unconditional D-transcendence of Volterra functions mu(t,beta,alpha) and nu(t) (2D Fermi gas 2nd virial shift and 1D 3-body 3rd virial shift, in t and T > 0) plus the exact Laplace transform of nu; (3) unconditional joint differential independence of finite and countably infinite distinct-density prime-asymptotic OGF towers (given quantitative density PNT); (4) universal lift of the arbitrary-pole-order rotated-ray HigherOrderStokes engine to strong D-transcendence over C({x}) (Bernoulli, tan, sec^p, Euler–Genocchi, trigamma, Lambert); (5) conditional implication showing RiemannHypothesis implies D-transcendence over C(x) and C({x}) of the von Mangoldt Borel-Laplace series G_Lambda; and (6) multi-scale Plancherel spectral-dominance and exact rational Collatz–Wielandt certification theorems. All 126 audited declarations depend strictly on standard axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
